command:
TARGET_FILE="/var/log/openfuyao-rayservice/openfuyao-ray.db"
TARGET_DIR="/var/log/openfuyao-rayservice"

echo "==== Checking if the directory is mounted successfully ===="
if [ -d "${TARGET_DIR}" ]; then
  echo "Directory exists: ${TARGET_DIR}"
  echo "Listing current files:"
  ls -l "${TARGET_DIR}"

  if [ -f "${TARGET_FILE}" ]; then
    echo "Target file found: ${TARGET_FILE}"
    echo "Attempting to delete the file..."
    rm -f "${TARGET_FILE}" && echo "File deleted successfully." || echo "Failed to delete the file."
  else
    echo "Target file does not exist: ${TARGET_FILE}"
  fi
else
  echo "Directory does not exist: ${TARGET_DIR}"
fi

echo "Task completed. Exiting successfully."
exit 0
initContainers.name: cleanup-hostpath

command:
if [ ! -f /mnt/opt/openFuyao/mindio/*.zip ]; then
  echo "/mnt/opt/openFuyao/mindio has no zip file"
  tag=$(sh /tmp/mindio/obtain-version.sh)
  sh /tmp/mindio/download.sh $tag
else
  echo "mindio.zip found, skipping install..."
  unzip "/mnt/opt/openFuyao/mindio/*.zip" -d /tmp/mindio/
fi
sh /tmp/mindio/entrypoint.sh acp;
while true; do
  sleep 3600
done

nsenter -t 1 -i -m -n sh -c 'component="acp"; package=$(python3 -m pip list | grep -i $component | awk "{print $1}" | head -n 1); if [ -n "$package" ]; then python3 -m pip uninstall -y $package; fi; sleep 2; rm -rf /opt/openFuyao-npu-mindioacp;'
